notification_digest: Update NotificationPipeline so consecutive publish calls made before flush are grouped by actor into one delivered message. Add flush; it sends pending messages in first-seen actor order, joins that actor's message texts with '; ', and emits nothing for an empty buffer. Preserve the current actor/message format. Calls after a flush start a new batch.
regional_policy: Keep the regional quote rules correct. North charges $4 plus $1.50 per kg and becomes free at subtotal $50 or above. South delivery estimates charge $6 plus $1 per kg and become free at subtotal $75 or above. Checkout follows the same southern base and weight rule, adds its existing $1 handling charge, and uses the $75 free-shipping threshold. Thresholds are inclusive; below each threshold, apply the applicable charges.
archive_export: Make ArchiveExporter publish atomically: if writing the header, any row, or finishing raises, no partial archive is visible and a later call can retry. A successful export publishes once; subsequent calls return :already_exported and do not write again. Propagate the original writer error.
